guarantees.claim: On positive edge of clk_i, when rst_ni is low, sw_key_data_reg[0] is cleared to 0.
When engine_stable is high, each 32-bit slice of sw_key_data_reg[0] corresponding to j is updated with reg2hw.key_share0[j].q if the associated qe signal is asserted.
When engine_stable is low and reset is not active, sw_key_data_reg[0] retains its previous value (no update occurs).

assumptions.claim: MaxKeyLen is a multiple of 32 so that the loop for j < MaxKeyLen/32 covers the entire key width with 32-bit slices.
assumptions.risk: If MaxKeyLen is not a multiple of 32, the highest‑order bits would not be captured or the part‑select width would be illegal.

assumptions.claim: When reg2hw.key_share0[j].qe is asserted, the associated reg2hw.key_share0[j].q value is stable and valid.
assumptions.risk: Metastable or incorrect key word capture, compromising the integrity of the secret key.

assumptions.claim: engine_stable is asserted only after all key shares have been completely written and are stable, and it is deasserted before any share changes.
assumptions.risk: Partial or inconsistent key assembly if the engine stable window does not enclose the entire sequence of qe assertions.

assumptions.claim: sw_key_data_reg[0] is a packed vector of width at least MaxKeyLen bits, allowing the part‑select [32*j+:32] for j up to MaxKeyLen/32-1.
assumptions.risk: Out‑of‑bounds part‑select results in synthesis or simulation error.

uncertain_points.claim: If engine_stable is deasserted while the key share loading sequence is only partially complete, sw_key_data_reg[0] may contain a mixture of new and old key words.
uncertain_points.cond: engine_stable transitions low before all required reg2hw.key_share0[j].qe pulses have been asserted.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect partial key may be used in KMAC operations, leading to data corruption or security failure.

uncertain_points.claim: sw_key_data_reg[0] is cleared only at reset; there is no in‑life clearing or wiping mechanism in this block.
uncertain_points.cond: After key usage, if a key wipe is required
uncertain_points.risk: Residual key material may be leaked through subsequent accesses or physical attacks.

uncertain_points.claim: The timing of reg2hw.key_share0[j].qe assertions relative to engine_stable is not enforced here; a qe assertion while engine_stable is low would be missed.
uncertain_points.risk: Missed key word update leading to an incomplete or incorrect key.

uncertain_points.claim: The loop bound MaxKeyLen/32 uses integer division; if MaxKeyLen is not a multiple of 32, the highest part‑select width of 32 may exceed the actual key width.
uncertain_points.risk: Synthesis or elaboration error due to out‑of‑bounds part‑select.
